project.name: codenameone-spellcheck-dictionaries
project.description: Hunspell dictionaries the build tools add to an application that uses com.codename1.spellcheck.SpellChecker, one per language named by the spellcheck.languages build hint. Resolved by the build tools on demand, like a port, and never by a simulator run. Only dictionaries under permissive licenses are shipped: the SCOWL-derived English ones; the README of each, with its license, is under META-INF/licenses.
